title: Receivers expose different operations
purpose: Explain heterogeneous vendor receiver interfaces that Command hides from the invoker.
alt: 서로 다른 메서드를 제공하는 13개 가전 수신자 클래스와 공통 명령 인터페이스가 필요한 이유
requiredChecks: All thirteen original receiver classes are present with their listed operations.
Methods remain associated with the correct receiver; no invented shared vendor superclass.
The diagram explains varying receiver interfaces rather than claiming every receiver only supports on/off.
prompt: Create a NEW ORIGINAL raster technical diagram for an IT study blog, opaque white background, clean navy sans-serif typography, restrained blue/teal/amber flat cards, spacious margins, exact monospaced class and method identifiers, no logos, source screenshots or copied slide composition.
